name: The Case of the Catacombs: A Tale from Atruxia
source:
A buddy-cop rom-com set in a medieval fantasy world, where a strict officer teams up with a flirtatious criminal in order to find a missing socialite in time for the Governor’s Ball.

Step into the shoes of Tupelo, the first and only Elf to join the City Guard, the policing force for the bustling city of Brexia.

Her positive attitude and eagerness to meticulously follow the rules has made her very unpopular in the gritty and sometimes corrupt police force.

In a risky attempt to gain respect, she bets her career on missing person’s case that will take her down into the creepy catacombs beneath the enormous city.

Luckily she isn’t alone. Tupelo tricks a thief, Keane, into helper her navigate the labyrinth of tunnels. As the two go deeper, the case takes a strange turn, and the two need to help each other, at great risk.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3895980/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部以中世纪幻想世界为背景的好友警察浪漫喜剧，一名严厉的警官与一名轻浮的罪犯联手，以便及时找到一位失踪的社交名流，参加州长舞会。

扮演图珀洛的角色，他是第一个也是唯一一个加入城市守卫队的精灵，城市守卫队是繁华的布雷西亚市的警察部队。

她积极的态度和一丝不苟地遵守规则的渴望使她在坚韧不拔、有时甚至腐败的警察队伍中非常不受欢迎。

为了赢得尊重，她冒险尝试将自己的职业生涯押在失踪人员案件上，这将把她带入这座大城市地下令人毛骨悚然的地下墓穴。

幸运的是她并不孤单。图珀洛诱骗小偷基恩帮助她穿越迷宫般的隧道。随着两人的深入，案情出现诡异转折，两人需要互相帮助，冒着巨大的风险。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3895980/]Steam[/url]]
